design: lambda create-function needs a zip file (--zip-file fileb://) or S3/ECR code; the CLI --code shorthand has no ZipFile key (create-function CLI reference). Tasks allow only aws/curl/dig commands and no local files, so the routine part (execution role + function) is a CloudFormation stack with inline ZipFile code (Handler index.handler, per AWS::Lambda::Function Code). Stack tags carry book=saa and task=<id>; CloudFormation propagates stack tags to the resources (create-stack CLI reference).

lambda-t03 keeps the planned order but has no separate receive-message after the synchronous call (8-step limit): the final receive shows one record, not two, and the explain of the break-it step says why.
Lambda creates the log group /aws/lambda/<function> at the first invocation (monitoring-cloudwatchlogs page); it is outside the stack, so each Try deletes it in its cleanup.
Cost lines name no dollar amount above $0. No SQS or CloudFormation price fact exists in the canon, so the SQS cost is a pointer to the Amazon SQS pricing page.

commands: aws lambda invoke --function-name saa-lambda-t03 --invocation-type Event response.json
check_cli_false_positive.why_false: In the CLI reference synopsis of lambda invoke, <outfile> is a positional argument (docs/cli/latest/reference/lambda/invoke, Synopsis). The CLI implements it as a StreamingOutputArgument without the -- prefix, so --outfile would be an unknown option in a real shell. No command form satisfies both the CLI and the helper.
check_cli_false_positive.fix_needed_in: aws-saa-book/tools/helpers/cli_model.py: treat an argument whose cli_name has no -- prefix (StreamingOutputArgument, name outfile) as positional, in _positional_room and in the required-option check. Until then T113 blocks the --ship form (counts gate) for chapter 18; the tasks gate (without --ship) only warns.
check_cli_false_positive.not_changed_by_this_stage: the helper was left as it is; tooling is outside this stage
